label: T1 — Key & Lock
description: Agent finds KEY_BLUE, unlocks DOOR_1, and reaches Hallway A. The door re-locks every 8 steps.

label: T2 — Fragment Assembly
description: Agent collects 4 fragments across 3 rooms and returns to the assembly zone.

label: T3 — Moving Target
description: Agent chases a drifting token that moves every 3 steps. Must pick it up before it gets out of reach.

label: T4 — Cartographer
description: Agent must visit all 5 rooms (hub + 4 wings) with a door that re-locks periodically.

label: T5 — Relay Race
description: Agent carries a fragile relic through 4 rooms and delivers it within 50 steps. Drop it and the run fails.

label: T6 — The Labyrinth
description: Corridors reshuffle every 10 steps in a 5-room labyrinth. The agent must collect 3 fragments while the map keeps changing.
